name: ZCA_OBJECT_PROPERTIES
description: This tables  stores the properties as name value pair.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: It specifies the primary key of the table.

columns.name: PARENT_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: It specifies the parent id of a specfic property.

columns.name: PROPERTY_TYPE
columns.description: It specifies the type of the property.

columns.name: LANG_INDEPENDENT_CODE
columns.description: It specifies the Language Independent Code of the object, to which the property belongs to.

columns.name: ATTR_NAME
columns.description: Specifies name of the Attribute , to which the property belongs to.

columns.name: PROPERTY_NAME
columns.description: It specifies the name of the property. It is specfied in the StandardObjectMetaData.xml file

columns.name: PROPERTY_VALUE
columns.description: It specifies the value of the property. It is specified in the StandardObjectMetaData.xml file

columns.name: PROPERTY_GROUP
columns.description: It specifies  to which group the property belongs to like Object, Attribute or Relation

columns.name: PROPERTY_CATEGORY
columns.description: SPecifies the Category of the Property whether it is a Property of Object, Attribute or Relation

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
